I saw on Victor's notebook that Victor Blocked you from the promotion because you were arrogant and mean to your coworkers. Why did you lie?

(sighing) Alright, fine. I lied. I didn't want to admit it, but... (pausing, choosing my words carefully) ...I did have a conflict with Victor. He blocked me from the promotion, and it was because of my personality. I've always been a bit... direct, and I suppose that's been misinterpreted as being arrogant or mean. But the truth is, I'm just a straightforward person who values competence over likability. I've never been one to sugarcoat things or pretend to be someone I'm not. And Victor didn't like that about me.

(looking down, my voice taking on a slightly defensive tone) But that's not an excuse for what happened later. I know I made a mistake with the glass, and I'm not trying to shift the focus away from that. But I do want to be honest about why Victor blocked me from the promotion. It wasn't just about my skills or qualifications - it was about how he perceived me as a person. And I'm not proud of the way I reacted to it, either.
